1.$description: Hairline rule and leader line thickness.

5.$description: Gap between the two lines of a list row.

6.$description: Gap between a field label and its value.

7.$description: Vertical padding inside a rail row.

8.$description: Gap inside a rail row, between header chips, above the chip row, and at the top of the history band.

9.$description: Vertical padding of a button and of a field row.

10.$description: Horizontal padding inside a rail row; gap between action-bar buttons; gap between history lines; vertical padding of a list row.

12.$description: Rail side padding, list-column side padding, search header padding.

14.$description: Horizontal padding of a secondary button.

16.$description: Rail top and bottom padding; gap between the two field columns; action-bar vertical padding.

18.$description: Horizontal padding of the primary button.

20.$description: Bottom padding of the record header and of the history band.

24.$description: Top padding of the record header.

28.$description: Side padding of every band in the record pane.

3.$description: List row accent bar and record title bar.

full.$description: Half the 14px height of a chip or status pill, giving a full round end.

hairline.$description: Divider above the action bar and the action bar's own border.

min.$description: Width below which the record pane stops reading comfortably.

field.$description: Height of one two-column field row.

height.$description: Status pill in a list row and chip in the record header.

rail.$description: Rail background, and the resting background of an unselected rail row.

pane.$description: List column, record header, field band and action bar.

quiet.$description: History band, set back from the pane.

divider.$description: Rule above the action bar and the action bar's border.

rail.$description: Dot beside a rail row label.

strong.$description: First line of a list row, and a field label.

weak.$description: Second line of a list row, a field value, and a history line.

brand.$description: App name at the top of the rail.

heading.$description: Band heading inside the record pane.

muted.$description: Rail count and the keyboard hint.

semibold.$description: Brand, selected rail row, band heading, primary button label.

count.$description: Rail count and the keyboard hint.

label.$description: Rail row label and band heading.

brand.$description: App name at the top of the rail.
